newsitem.title: USA: Brown & Williamson completes tobacco sale.
newsitem.headline: Brown & Williamson completes tobacco sale.

text.p: Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corp said Friday that it has completed selling six former American Tobacco brands to Commonwealth Tobacco LLC of Bowling Green, Kentucky.
The sale includes domestic rights to the Montclair, Malibu, Riviera, Crowns, Special 10's and Bull Durham, the company said. It also includes a cigarette manufacturing plant in Reidsville, N.C.
The sale was required by the Federal Trade Commission issued in 1994 after Brown & Williamson, a subsidiary of B.A.T. Industries Plc, bought American Tobacco Co.
